Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 12
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly reinterpreted “longest win streak” to mean a “wins-only (no ties)” streak and concluded 22 games (2017 Indians), despite authoritative evidence showing MLB’s recognized record is 26 games by the 1916 New York Giants. Baseball-Reference explicitly lists “Longest Winning Streak: 26,” and MLB policy (as cited on Wikipedia) notes that ties do not end a winning streak. This improper synthesis and scope shift led to the wrong final answer.
